Parallel subagents: 4 signal agents, 1 spend-pass agent, 6 research agents, 6 reviewers, 4 finalizers; their fetches are included (deduplicated). Six reviewed: 1 killed, 5 rescored down, 4 shipped provisional, none validated. Findings for future runs: (1) A12 HN is low-yield for this lens: 15 Algolia queries gave one first-person maker complaint (robotmay). Unquoted queries match loosely; 'OR' returns 0; use quoted phrases plus numericFilters=created_at_i>epoch. (2) New A13 hosts that work for craft sellers: talk.folksy.com (UK makers, search.json and /t/{id}.json) and sellersasksellers.com (multi-marketplace sellers). Discourse search ANDs all words: use 1-2 words plus after:. (3) About half of 2026 community.shopify.com posts in maker niches are app developers; read whole topics. (4) B12: an app's own review count is the JSON-LD aggregateRating ratingCount; other '(N)' figures on the page belong to other apps. Slug etsy-integration-sync redirects to etsy-integration-dpl. Square App Marketplace pages show no prices or reviews in HTML, and squareup.com rate-limits (429, Cloudflare 1015) after a few requests. Xero App Store search pages are empty to both clients; find apps by web search. (5) B11 freelancer.com API barely narrows by query and returned almost no task-specific jobs across about 60 queries; PeoplePerHour ignores ?q=. (6) federalregister.gov HTML pages 302 to a bot wall; the per-document API /api/v1/documents/{number}.json works. (8) api.wordpress.org queries need curl -g because of brackets. (9) Feasibility facts worth reusing: Square's public API has no Classes support (Square staff, 2025-09-12 and 2026-04-23); Xero's Accounting API does not expose unreconciled bank statement lines; Shopify App Store rule 1.1.2 bars apps that bypass checkout; Etsy commercial API access is under manual review with reported denials through 2026-10.
